prompt: Implement Python function blast_candidates(xml_text, record, rid) using Bio.Blast.NCBIXML.read(StringIO(xml_text)) and Bio.SeqFeature.SimpleLocation. Only accept parsed.application.upper()=='BLASTX' and parsed.query_length==len(record) else ValueError. For each alignment and hsp: identity=hsp.identities/hsp.align_length, coverage=(abs(hsp.sbjct_end-hsp.sbjct_start)+1)/alignment.length. require identity>=.7 coverage>=.7 evalue<=1e-5, min(query_start,query_end)>=1 max<=len(record). Strand sign from hsp.frame[0]; use SimpleLocation(min(qstart,qend)-1,max(qstart,qend),strand=sign). Hit dict keys entry (feature_id='blast:'+alignment.accession, canonical_name=alignment.hit_def, feature_type='misc_feature',source='https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Blast.cgi?CMD=Get&RID='+rid,version=rid),location,identity,coverage,match='protein_variant',confidence='Review required',status='new',method='blastx',evalue=hsp.expect,bitscore=hsp.bits. Return results, [] if no hits. Reject zero/invalid lengths. Do not label full CDS or use subject coordinates for genomic location. No other functions. Python only.
